label.purpose: Navigation, eyebrows, buttons, and data terms.

components.name: Hero Button
components.description: Forest parent action used in the landing hero.
components.css: .ds-button-hero { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:14px 22px; background:#1C3B2E; color:#FAF7F2; border:1px solid #1C3B2E; border-radius:0; font:400 12px/1.4 'Space Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none; transition:background .22s ease,border-color .22s ease; } .ds-button-hero:hover { background:#142B21; border-color:#142B21; } .ds-button-hero:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #E03A1F; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Signal Button
components.description: Red decisive action used for Smart Move and relocation handoffs.
components.css: .ds-button-signal { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:14px 22px; background:#E03A1F; color:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid #E03A1F; border-radius:0; font:400 12px/1.4 'Space Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none; transition:background .22s ease,border-color .22s ease; } .ds-button-signal:hover { background:#C93318; border-color:#C93318; } .ds-button-signal:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #E03A1F; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Editorial Link Card
components.description: Flat square related-content card with a mono type label.
components.html: GUIDEFlood risk and insurance→
components.css: .ds-editorial-card { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto; gap:4px 12px; min-height:68px; padding:14px 16px; background:#FAF7F2; color:#0D0D0D; border:1px solid #E7E1D8; border-radius:0; text-decoration:none; transition:border-color .18s ease,background-color .18s ease; } .ds-editorial-card:hover,.ds-editorial-card:focus-visible { border-color:#E03A1F; background:#FFFFFF; } .ds-card-kind { grid-column:1/-1; color:#6B6B6B; font:400 12px/1.4 'Space Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.14em; } .ds-card-title { font:600 17px/1.15 'Instrument Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: Paper masthead with linked parent wordmark and compact Houston navigation.
components.css: .ds-masthead { height:60px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:0 24px; background:#FAF7F2; color:#0D0D0D; border-bottom:1px solid #E7E1D8; } .ds-masthead a { min-height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; color:inherit; text-decoration:none; } .ds-masthead div { display:flex; gap:24px; font:400 12px/1.4 'Space Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.14em; } .ds-wordmark { font:700 16px/1 'Instrument Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.06em; } .ds-wordmark span { color:#C93318; } .ds-masthead a:hover { color:#C93318; } .ds-masthead a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #E03A1F; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: The incumbent system feels like a well-edited field guide: direct, regional, source-conscious, and useful in the real world. Warm paper and assertive display type keep it human; mono labels, hairline structures, and schematic maps make complex regional information easy to scan. The experience is editorial rather than promotional and confident without looking luxurious or theatrical.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper, forest, signal red, and ink.
Mono system labels and readable long-form body copy.
Flat color fields, square geometry, and hairline grids.
Source panels, adjacent disclaimers, and schematic accuracy captions.
Restrained, optional motion with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Forest establishes the world; red marks attention, focus, and decisive action. Preserve the observed forest hero action and red relocation CTA as distinct variants.

rules.name: The Small-Text Red Rule
rules.body: Use #C93318 for small red text on paper. Keep #E03A1F for fills, borders, focus, and large display marks.

rules.name: The System-Label Rule
rules.body: Space Mono is for navigation, labels, buttons, and data terms, not headlines or prose.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Separate information with color fields, spacing, and hairlines—never decorative elevation.

dos: Do preserve the parent JWILLSOLDIT wordmark and red dot across every surface.
Do keep source panels, review dates, and relevant disclaimers visible.
Do use accessible red text for small red copy on paper.
Do retain keyboard focus, touch-target, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glassmorphism, rounded SaaS cards, or dark dashboard styling.
Don't restore the location finder, public methodology page, or generic community stubs as a visual-design side effect.
Don't rank communities or visually imply desirability, safety, school quality, or demographic fit.
Don't use motion that competes with reading or ignores reduced-motion preferences.
